scope: 34 queue-1 standalone historians; life metadata only. Current status checks use recent institutional/author evidence and targeted death searches; missing Wikidata P570 is not proof of life.
method: Read existing reviewed date sheet as lead/provenance, independently identify people by distinctive careers/works, inspect cited page text/search-returned extracts, preserve precision and flag conflicts. Historical precise sheet values are retained separately only when no fresh day conflict was found.

search_scope.living_queries: Each of the ten living-classified names searched with2026 and obituary/died/death (or décès), in addition to positive sources; irrelevant namesake notices were rejected by career/identity.
search_scope.access_limit: Search-returned text is stated in source scope; no claim to have read whole books, archive collections or uninspected civil certificates.
